title: Aligarh Muslim University v. Naresh Agarwal

content.caseIdentity: Aligarh Muslim University v. Naresh Agarwal, 2024 INSC 856
content.holding: A seven-judge Constitution Bench overruled the Azeez Basha proposition that statutory incorporation by itself prevents an institution from being established by a minority, and laid down principles for assessing minority character; it left AMU’s final status to the regular Bench.
content.relevance: Current constitutional authority on the indicia of establishment and minority character under Article 30(1).

evidence.note: Official Supreme Court judgment material confirms the cited case and its recorded proposition; verification is provenance-level and does not promote publication status.
